A '''bumble-dice cup''' was an object in the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] compared the ground shocks caused by meteor strikes to a [[Touranian jumping-stone]] in a bumble-dice
cup.<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>
